story: Edit an existing brand template, replace local media, save/import configuration, export an independent offline page and play its media.
live_brand_and_copy: brand, auto-updated seal, collection, literal angle-bracket text and theme updated in preview
local_media: existing WebP and MP4 imported through real file inputs; no upload endpoint
optional_product: hidden by default; export blocked without name/image; supplied test fields then rendered
exported_html: opened from a separate directory with no assets folder; replaced media plays, edited content persists, no editor controls
config_round_trip: downloaded JSON restored brand, content, product and local media after loading another preset
invalid_import: invalid action URL rejected; current edits retained
mobile_editor: 390px: edit/preview switches, phone preview and no horizontal overflow
